segments.text: they blew up a dead whale on a beach full of people, and it rained whale.
Blubber sailed right over the crowd. People ran for their cars.
The plan? Twenty cases of dynamite. Blow it into bits small enough for the seagulls to eat.
One man there knew explosives from the military. He warned it was way too much, and stood way back.
Then, a quarter of a mile away, a slab of whale came down right on his new car, and crushed the roof.
He'd bought it days before, in a sale called: a whale of a deal.
Road crews had to clean up the rest. And the engineer in charge?
He said it went just exactly right. Fifty years later, the town named a park after it: Exploding Whale Memorial Park.
